en:
Students must live at the Ultimate Academy for
the remainder of their foreseeable future.

Once a murder takes place, all surviving
students must participate in a <CLT=5>class trial<CLT=0>.

If the blackened is exposed during the class
trial, <CLT=5>they alone will be executed<CLT=0>.

If the blackened is not exposed, <CLT=5>all remaining
students will be executed<CLT=0>.

If the blackened survives the class trial, they
will graduate and <CLT=5>re-enter the outside world<CLT=0>.

The killing game and class trials will continue
until only two surviving students remain.

<CLT=5>"Nighttime"<CLT=0> is from 10 p.m. to 8 a.m. The dining
hall and gymnasium are off-limits at night.

Violence toward Monokuma, the headmaster of
the Ultimate Academy, is strictly prohibited.

Monokuma will never directly commit
a murder.

Your Monopads are very important items.
Please do not damage them.

The "<CLT=5>Body Discovery Announcement<CLT=0>" will play
when three or more students discover a body.

With minimal restrictions, you are <CLT=5>free<CLT=0> to
explore the campus at your discretion.

Students who violate these rules will be
immediately <CLT=5>exterminated<CLT=0> by the Exisals.

<CLT=5>Swimming is prohibited<CLT=0> in the pool during nighttime. 
Touching the water is also against school rules.

If two different murders by different murderers occur at the same time, 
<CLT=5>only the one whose victim was found first<CLT=0> will be the blackened.

Further, there may be new additions to the school rules 
according to the convenience of the headmaster.
